block.berongsmp.evacuation_map.desc: Right-click to point yourself toward the nearest marked exit.
block.berongsmp.emergency_light.desc: Lights up automatically for the duration of any active simulation.
block.berongsmp.sprinkler_head.desc: Rains water below it during a fire, extinguishing at most one fire block at a time.
block.berongsmp.smoke_detector.desc: Sounds an alarm once fire is detected within range during a fire simulation.
block.berongsmp.exit_sign.desc: Always-lit wayfinding marker, readable even in smoke or blackout.
block.berongsmp.classroom_globe.desc: A desk globe for the geography corner.
block.berongsmp.podium_lectern.desc: A speaker's podium bearing the school seal.
block.berongsmp.blackboard.desc: A traditional green chalkboard with a chalk tray.
block.berongsmp.water_dispenser.desc: A bottled-water cooler. Right-click for a drink.
block.berongsmp.trophy_cabinet.desc: A glass-front cabinet displaying the school's trophies.
block.berongsmp.philippine_flag_stand.de: The Philippine flag on a brass pole stand.
block.berongsmp.tall_bookshelf.desc: A full-height library bookshelf — plenty of fuel for a library fire.
block.berongsmp.armchair_desk.desc: A classic Philippine classroom armchair-desk with a writing-tablet arm.
block.berongsmp.teachers_desk.desc: The teacher's desk, with a drawer pedestal.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_table.desc: A long lunch table with attached bench seats.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_tray_stack.des: A stack of colored plastic lunch trays.
block.berongsmp.serving_counter.desc: A steam-table serving counter with a sneeze guard. Stack two for a full-height guard.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_menu_board.des: A chalk-surface board listing today's menu.
block.berongsmp.condiment_station.desc: Ketchup, mustard, and a napkin holder on a metal tray.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_trash_bin.desc: A dual recycle/trash bin with swing-flap lids.
block.berongsmp.soda_fountain_machine.de: A drink dispenser with a selection panel and fill nozzle.
block.berongsmp.cafeteria_stool.desc: A round vinyl-seat stool on a chrome pole.
block.berongsmp.salad_bar.desc: A refrigerated salad bar with chilled produce wells. Stack two for a full-height guard.
block.berongsmp.snack_vending_machine.de: A glass-front snack machine. Stack two for a full-height unit with a lit marquee.
block.berongsmp.computer.desc: Right-click to turn on/off. Set alight with flint and steel — only a CO2 extinguisher puts it out.
block.berongsmp.fire_alarm.desc: Right-click during a fire simulation to sound the alarm and log your response.
item.berongsmp.firefighter_helmet.desc: Part of the firefighter turnout uniform.
item.berongsmp.firefighter_coat.desc: Part of the firefighter turnout uniform.
item.berongsmp.firefighter_pants.desc: Part of the firefighter turnout uniform.
item.berongsmp.firefighter_boots.desc: Part of the firefighter turnout uniform.
berongsmp.configuration.title: Berong SMP Configs
block.berongsmp.whiteboard.desc: A glossy classroom whiteboard. Stack vertically to grow one tall board.
block.berongsmp.toilet.desc: A ceramic toilet. Right-click for a flush sound.
block.berongsmp.sink.desc: A wall-mounted sink. Right-click for a water sound.
block.berongsmp.computer_table.desc: A modern office desk for a classroom computer.
block.berongsmp.locker.desc: A painted-steel school locker with a keypad lock.
block.berongsmp.bulletin_board.desc: A felt pinboard with sticky notes and pins.
block.berongsmp.ceiling_fan.desc: A ceiling fan with a built-in light.
block.berongsmp.light_bulb.desc: A full-cube glowing ceiling tile. Tile several across a large room to light it evenly.
block.berongsmp.table.desc: An extendable study/library table. Push two together to merge them into one longer table.
block.berongsmp.court_line.desc: A white court-marking line that auto-connects to neighboring lines.
block.berongsmp.badminton_net_post.desc: Place two facing each other to auto-fill a net between them.
block.berongsmp.badminton_net_mesh.desc: An auto-filled net panel — not normally placed by hand.
block.berongsmp.basketball_hoop_post.des: The base of a basketball hoop stand. Place a hoop above it to auto-fill the pole.
block.berongsmp.basketball_pole.desc: An auto-filled pole segment — not normally placed by hand.
block.berongsmp.basketball_hoop.desc: A backboard, rim, and net. Auto-fills the pole down to the nearest post below it.
item.berongsmp.basketball.desc: A basketball for pickup games on the court.
block.berongsmp.plastic_trash_bin.desc: A vaping device left smoldering inside can flash into a fire if left unattended.
block.berongsmp.daisy_chain_extension.de: Too many devices sharing one cord risks an overloaded, arcing outlet.
block.berongsmp.woodshop_sawdust_layer.d: Fine sawdust builds up on the floor and can flash-ignite once it gets deep enough.
block.berongsmp.stage_spotlight.desc: An overheating lamp housing can scorch nearby rigging and curtains.
block.berongsmp.archive_box_stack.desc: A stack of paper document boxes is dense fuel for a fast-spreading fire.
block.berongsmp.dust_choked_pc.desc: Dust-clogged vents trap heat inside the case until components overheat.
block.berongsmp.charging_cart.desc: A rolling cart charging too many devices at once can overload its own wiring.
block.berongsmp.frayed_console_wire.desc: Bare copper exposed by a frayed wire can arc and ignite nearby carpet.
block.berongsmp.malfunctioning_vending.d: A shorted compressor can smoke and overheat the machine from the inside.
block.berongsmp.ceiling_projector.desc: A failed cooling fan lets internal heat build up until it starts smoking.
block.berongsmp.swollen_phone_battery.de: A thermally swollen battery can vent flammable gas without warning.
block.berongsmp.damaged_lipo_pack.desc: A punctured drone battery pack can smoke and ignite if left in place.
block.berongsmp.vape_in_iron_locker.desc: A vaping device left inside can overheat and smoke inside the closed locker.
block.berongsmp.pa_system_backup.desc: A faulty backup amplifier can arc and overheat its rack-mounted electronics.
block.berongsmp.smartboard_inverter.desc: Roof-leak water damage on the inverter risks a short circuit.
block.berongsmp.unattended_grease_pan.de: A frying pan left on a lit stove burner is one of the most common kitchen fire starters. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.grease_clogged_hood.desc: Built-up grease in a clogged range hood filter can ignite from the heat below. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.contaminated_kitchen_bin: Oil-soaked rags in the bin can self-heat and smoulder. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.jammed_panini_press.desc: Food jammed against a hot press plate can burn and smoke unattended. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.commercial_deep_fryer.de: An overheated deep fryer is a Class K oil fire risk. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher — never spray water or ABC powder on burning oil.
block.berongsmp.clogged_exhaust_fan.desc: A dust-caked, stalled motor can overheat and smoulder inside the housing.
block.berongsmp.alcohol_dispenser_statio: Sanitizer leaking near a power outlet is a flammable-liquid ignition risk.
block.berongsmp.leaking_gas_valve.desc: A leaking LPG line can flash-ignite the whole cafeteria kitchen area. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.unattended_shrine_candle: An open flame burning beside altar cloth is one of the fastest-failing hazards in the building.
block.berongsmp.jammed_laser_printer.des: Paper jammed against the fuser assembly can scorch and smoke.
Condensation leaking into the unit's own wiring risks an electrical short.
block.berongsmp.overloaded_breaker_panel: A panel drawing far more load than it's rated for can arc inside the box.
block.berongsmp.reagent_storage_shelf.de: A tipped, leaking reagent bottle gives off fumes across a wide area.
block.berongsmp.bunsen_burner_station.de: A burner left running unattended is an open flame next to lab chemicals.
block.berongsmp.overloaded_microwave.des: An overloaded microwave can arc internally and catch fire if left running.
block.berongsmp.overloaded_wall_outlet.d: Place on a classroom or office wall near a desk. Sparks and overheats when hazardous — left unattended, it can scorch the wall alight.
block.berongsmp.jammed_circuit_breaker.d: Place on a utility corridor or electrical room wall. Its trip switch is jammed, so an overload has nothing left to stop it — defuse before it flashes over.
block.berongsmp.unsealed_solvent_shelf.d: Place in an art room or shop-class storage area. Open paint-thinner/lacquer cans give off flammable vapor that can flash-ignite a 2-block radius.
block.berongsmp.unattended_welding_stati: Place in a vocational shop-class workshop. Left running, hot spatter from the arc welder can ignite nearby combustibles.
block.berongsmp.leaking_butane_canister_: Place in a kitchen or canteen prep area. The portable burner leaks gas at the canister seam — only the wet chemical extinguisher can safely defuse it.
block.berongsmp.modern_student_desk.desc: Place in a classroom for a single student — pairs with a separate Chair block. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.science_lab_workbench.de: Place in a science lab as a surface for lab hazard props (Bunsen Burner Station, Reagent Storage Shelf). Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.computer_lab_desk_row.de: Place in an ICT/computer lab as a long shared desk with a monitor-divider back edge. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.library_study_carrel.des: Place in the library for an individual partitioned study spot. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.rolling_book_cart.desc: Place in the library as a mobile stack of returned books — extra fuel load for a library fire drill. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.kitchen_prep_counter.des: Place in the back-of-house kitchen area for food prep, distinct from the front-line Serving Counter. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.dishwashing_sink_station: Place in the kitchen for a commercial triple-basin wash sink. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.beverage_juice_dispenser: Place on a canteen serving line for a gravity-fed drink dispenser, distinct from the carbonated Soda Fountain Machine and the bottled Water Dispenser. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.cutlery_napkin_caddy.des: Place on a cafeteria table or serving counter as a small tabletop accent. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.serving_hatch_window.des: Place on a kitchen wall as a pass-through hatch to the serving line, distinct from a freestanding counter. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.fire_extinguisher_cabine: Place on a corridor or classroom wall to display an extinguisher, distinct from the hose-reel Fire Hose Cabinet. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.assembly_point_sign.desc: Place standing at your building's outdoor assembly area to mark the evacuation muster point, distinct from the Emergency Exit Sign which marks doors. Always lit. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.first_aid_wall_cabinet.d: Place on a classroom, corridor, or clinic wall as a fixed first-aid station. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.fire_safety_poster.desc: Place on any classroom or corridor wall to teach the PASS extinguisher technique and the fire triangle. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.blocked_exit_clutter.des: Place jammed against a doorway as a training prop illustrating an obstructed emergency exit. Flammable — it will burn if a nearby fire reaches it, but does not ignite on its own.
block.berongsmp.conference_table.desc: Place in a boardroom for a dark-laminate table on chrome legs. Tiles side-by-side into one long table, same as the study Table. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.executive_office_chair.d: Place at a conference table for a high-back leather swivel chair. Flammable. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.conference_credenza.desc: Place along a boardroom wall for a low walnut sideboard with sliding doors. Flammable. Decor only, no interaction.
Place on a boardroom wall for a dark standby flat-panel meeting display. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.flip_chart_easel.desc: Place beside a conference table for an A-frame paper flip-chart easel. Flammable. Decor only, no interaction.
Place on a boardroom table for a three-legged speakerphone centerpiece. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.glass_office_partition.d: Place to divide an open office into a frosted-glass-walled meeting space. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.lounge_sofa.desc: Place in a reception or waiting area for a two-seat fabric sofa. Flammable. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.potted_office_plant.desc: Place as a floor accent for a broadleaf plant in a terracotta pot. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.window_blinds.desc: Place on a window wall for half-open venetian blinds. Decor only, no interaction.
block.berongsmp.chefs_prep_drawers.desc: Place in a culinary classroom near a stove. An oily rag left draped by the burner can self-ignite. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.culinary_fridge.desc: Place in a culinary classroom or kitchen. Dust-caked coils and a failing relay can overheat the compressor — a Class C electrical fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.student_lab_microwave.de: Place on a counter or prep table for student use. Metal or foil left inside can arc violently — a Class C electrical fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
Place on a kitchen wall as fixed gas piping. A rusted-through elbow joint can weep gas and flash over. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.gas_range_stuck_burner.d: Place in a culinary classroom kitchen line. A melted control knob can jam a burner open, flaring across the range. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.commercial_stand_mixer.d: Place on a prep counter for bread-dough work. A motor jammed by stiff dough can overheat — a Class C electrical fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.gas_deck_oven.desc: Place in a culinary classroom baking area. A stuck thermostat and cracked door can radiate heat onto nearby items. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.induction_cooktop_statio: Place on a counter for electric cooking demos. A failed cooling fan can overheat the electronics under the glass — a Class C fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.rice_cooker_bank.desc: Place on a counter as a row of student rice cookers. Boiling one dry can scorch its base — a Class C fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.espresso_machine.desc: Place on a café/canteen counter. A scale-blocked pressure valve can over-pressurize the boiler and short the controls — a Class C fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.hot_water_urn.desc: Place on a canteen counter for tea/coffee service. A dripping spigot can short the base electrics — a Class C fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.toaster_oven_crumb.desc: Place on a counter for student snack use. A packed crumb tray can ignite under the heating element — a Class A fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.dry_goods_pantry_shelf.d: Place against a pantry wall. Open flour/sugar sacks near a hot light fixture can flash-ignite airborne dust across a 2-block radius. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.grease_duct_run.desc: Place on a kitchen ceiling above the cooking line. Grease caked inside the ductwork can catch fire — a hidden hazard distinct from the range hood below it. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.commercial_dish_sanitize: Place under a kitchen counter run. A dry-boiled heating element and steam seeping into the control board can spark a fire — a Class C fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.garbage_disposal_unit.de: Place beneath a sink block. A utensil-jammed grinder can burn out its motor — a Class C fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.knife_sterilizer_cabinet: Place on a kitchen wall to sanitize knives and utensils. An overheated UV-lamp ballast can scorch the housing — a Class C fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.sterno_steam_table.desc: Place on a buffet/serving line. Unattended gel-fuel (Sterno) chafing burners can flare up. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.convection_oven.desc: Place in a culinary classroom baking area. A shorted heating element and fan motor behind a failed door gasket can catch fire — a Class C fire. Any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.lechon_rotisserie_spit.d: Place in an outdoor/covered cooking area for a charcoal spit roast. Fat dripping onto unattended coals can flare up. Requires the wet chemical extinguisher.
block.berongsmp.portable_space_heater.de: Place in a conference room near papers. A tipped heater can ignite anything against its grille. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
block.berongsmp.halogen_floor_lamp.desc: Place beside curtains for a torchiere floor lamp. A tipped lamp's white-hot bowl can scorch fabric alight. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
block.berongsmp.jammed_projection_screen: Place on a conference room ceiling. A stalled retract motor can overheat its housing. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
block.berongsmp.overheating_video_wall.d: Place on a boardroom wall for a multi-panel LED display. A failed driver stack can overheat behind the panels. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
block.berongsmp.aerosol_freshener_dispen: Place on a wall away from heat sources. Mounted above a heat register, its propellant mist can flash over. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
block.berongsmp.smothered_laptop.desc: Place on soft furniture. A laptop left running with its vents buried can overheat and ignite the upholstery. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
block.berongsmp.smoldering_planter.desc: Place as office floor decor. A discarded cigarette can smolder in dry peat potting mix. Plain Class A fire — any extinguisher defuses it.
block.berongsmp.pinched_tv_cord.desc: Place behind a wall-mounted display. A cord crushed flat by its mount bracket can arc through split insulation. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
block.berongsmp.venting_ups_battery.desc: Place under a credenza. A failing lead-acid cell off-gasses hydrogen that can flash over. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
block.berongsmp.faulty_dimmer_switch.des: Place on a conference room wall. An over-lamped dimmer's triac can scorch through its faceplate. Wet chemical won't defuse it — use ABC or CO2.
